content: Bulus nǝ Balnas a Ikoniya
A Ikoniya Bulus isǝ Balnabas is tege' lu dobga ki Yahudawa kan u nǝs kuɗa u is dlǝm shilǝn ki Lya hal i hwu' Yahudawa ne' ginǝ bǝ Yahudawa wai u la'mbadli.
Amma Yahudawa ginǝ nge la'ti mbadli is ho' ginǝ bǝ Yahudawa wai u is kon nǝ dlomwasǝn ne' yelsǝniwasǝn.
I ki Bulus nǝ Balnabas is lǝmdǝp tyaka, si dlǝp shilǝn ki Lya nǝ ndǝtl ki mbadli, i' pǝl enti nǝ dwaɗǝn tǝn shilǝn ki alheli wasi gunǝ la'si ɗǝ pǝtl ulki gagashintu.
I mbalǝn ki ge' gatli bwassi; nami tǝn Yahudawa, genne si tǝn kal ki mi'shinkǝn.
I ki gyen ginǝ bǝ Yahudawa wai u nǝ Yahudawa ne' mi'kinawasǝn, is kǝndi sǝl la'si ge' sha as la'si nǝ zǝnga.
Amma nǝs kum shilǝn nǝ u, is kitǝl tyage' gatl ki Likoniya ki Listila nǝ Dalba, nǝ atl ki malgǝni.
Alǝbǝ sǝ mbǝl dlǝp shilǝn ki Lya tǝnki.
A Listila nǝ Dalba
A Listila mulǝn ɗa ki dǝmi atli dakǝlkǝni, nǝgu sǝ'zǝtti ta lǝm lǝ' gason wai.
Ti ga'ki' shilǝn ki Bulus kǝm, i Bulus uti' dwaɗǝn, i' en la'ti mbatl ni'ɗa akǝm ki ndo'twasi,
it ultisu nǝ ndǝlti, “Hilya tǝn asǝnwagi!” Gaki nǝgu, i muli pe' lya i' gob lǝti.
Nǝ hwu' mbalǝn yen ulnǝ Bulus pǝli u, is la' yali nǝbi ki Likoniya is usu, “Inngu lya yen a ndemin suɗǝ kǝnǝ mbalǝn!”
Balnabas is mbekki Zapsa, tine Bulus is mbekki Hamisa gaki tikǝ mulkina ki shilǝn.
Iki i laɓa ki zapsa, gunǝ libi pǝtl gontwas a kal gatlu, immbǝl bas tla nǝ dwaɗǝn ki buzha pǝtti abidlabi gatli, gaki ti ne' mbalǝn si lyap pǝli'si hadaya.
Amma ki Balnabas isǝ Bulus, nǝs kumgu' u, is kyash lu'lǝgǝlwasǝn is te'ge' mbalǝni nǝ kitǝl, asi tlǝlyal:

“Yelǝnsi, ya laki i' pǝlǝn nǝ guɗa? Mima mbalǝnni, kǝnǝ kini. Shilǝn ki Lya kǝn mi mbǝlli' kini, ɗǝ utlkinsu ki' zakǝn ulnǝ bǝ mbunwai u, a' palni ma' Lya mul mbadli, gunǝ pǝl lya nǝ atlu, nǝ basmal, nǝ mus ulnǝ ge'si u.
Tini tun teɗi is za' mbalǝn sǝ' bǝl shitu u nǝ si lyamti u.
Ngo nǝnǝgu taza' gawas ba mi' enti nǝ dwaɗǝwai, tǝn gaki ti pǝli' alheli, ti gunǝ ɗǝ pǝli'kin mal ki lya ne' lǝɓa ki ge' gu ki watlin; ti bǝtlkin ulki ɗami iye, ti njǝkǝnkin nǝ hwoltugi.”
Mus nǝ shilǝngi, nǝ ngeskǝn sǝ hane mbalǝn hadaya gawasǝn.
I Yahudawa yen pe'te' Antakiya nǝ Ikoniya is shel mbalǝni. Is lalla' Bulus is dǝlti kal gatli, si yenti kǝnǝ ta mǝcci.
Amma i mi' bǝtl Yesu kal is dopga is gadǝlti, i' hilya ippaltya ge' gatli. Lucili is lǝ Dalba isǝ Balnabas.
Patl te' Antakiya age' Suliya
Is dlim shilǝn ki Lya a ge gatli is mbi mi' bǝtl Yesu kal diɓǝli. Iki is paltya Listila nǝ Ikoniya nǝ kuma Antakiya,
Si ndǝlli' mi' bǝtl Yesu kal mbadli, si dǝlissi kǝm sǝ' dlil tǝn la'ti mbalwasǝn. “Nǝ bǝna mul diɓǝtl kǝn tǝn ten ge' gu' ki Lya,” Is usu.
Bulus nǝ Balnabas is ollisi mi'kina hu lu dobga ki mi' bǝtl Yesu kalu kǝni, nǝ shilǝn nǝ Lya nǝ ngap tibi, is za'si a toh ɗǝ Lya, gunǝ tǝnti sǝ la' mbadlu.
Nǝs pa' du' a Bisidiya u, is mbǝ a Bampiliya.
Nǝs dlǝm shilǝn ki Lya a Baliyata u, is su Ataliya.
Te' Ataliya is paltya Antakiya ge' kudǝlǝn ki mal, ge' lu' u nǝ teɗi shilǝn nǝ Lya gawasǝn ɗa u is mbi alheli ki pa'ti kyautǝn ɗa.
Mbǝkǝshtiwasǝn tyaka, is domi mi' bǝtl Yesu kal ga is dlǝm mus ulnǝ Lya pǝli tu' ma'si u, nǝ kan unǝ' ɓuldlabi imi' gǝnǝ bǝ Yahudawai u mbi pe'tu.
Is lǝm dǝp tya ka ne' mi' bǝtl Yesu kal.
